Before you start creating your first Gorgias app you need to choose between two types of apps: Private apps These apps should be used if you plan to access only your own Gorgias account data. You don't need to follow any special process to create a private app. For the authentication method, you can use Access Tokens . Public apps These apps are published in our App Store and are available to thousands of shop owners. You need to follow a specific process which includes a review from the Gorgias team.
